name: Portland
summary: A private-client law firm in a grand London house: Portland stone in low sun. One carved sentence in Marcellus capitals beside a photograph of the firm's own panelled library, the SRA digital badge directly under the first call to action, the practice set large as a ruled index beside the stair, discreet arrival beside the white stucco house, and regulation set as a stone plate. Lit stone ground, soot text, the blue-grey of the shadow inside a carved letter for rules and links. Marcellus for the inscription, Source Sans 3 for everything else. Every photo in one stone grade. For private-client and family firms; a City look shares the same kit.
